full_name: Constance Ahrons | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: A professor of sociology and director of the Marriage and Family Therapy Training Program at the University of Southern California, Constance Ahrons is best known for her research focusing on issues of marriage and divorce.
